meta.name: Shakha Proshakha
meta.description: Drowning in debt while trying to save her critically ill daughter, Nandita's last hope is her in-laws' property. A letter reveals a dark blood secret, shattering the family. Amid lies and manipulation, she searches for the truth. Will it break her, or set her free?

videos.title: Uttoradhikar
videos.overview: After her husband's suicide, Nandita attends her mother-in-law's funeral where the family lawyer unveils a letter!

videos.title: Rohoshyer Shuru
videos.overview: With Arnab the odd man out, Nandita is left penniless. Subhendu offers help, but who is following & searching her flat?
